comparisons: Each ablation as baseline, retained C3 as candidate; positive reduction is benefit of the removed feature in the context of the other features. Not additive attribution.
primary_metric: thread CPU time; retain wall time and all cases
controls: Unchanged relink versus baseline and baseline versus retained C3 before ablations, 4096/8192/16384 all shapes, 21 quartets, 10ms
interpretation: Use per-session aggregate 95% block-bootstrap intervals; a repeatable feature contribution requires same direction and CI excluding zero in both sessions. Inspect compiler output because scalar source may be vectorized. Carry ablation includes unrolling and while-to-if together.

application.workload: Uncached FLINT Chudnovsky pi via _mp_real_const_arb and mp_real_const_pi4(cache=0), then scale by four
application.correctness: Exact baseline/candidate ball equality and containment of MPFR directed-rounding pi endpoints at extra precision
application.control: Unchanged versus unchanged before application runs
application.report: Whole computation including internal allocations; output conversion/verification outside timing. No requirement to find an application win.
